scope: Read primary commit diffs and release API. Select private ports; no production installation, no full rebase yet.

cross_console_patterns.pattern: Reuse staging memory only after its fence has completed; wait on the relevant allocation. Host-visible allocation is a hypothesis, not a transferable gain. Our previous host-memory ring was slower and rejected.
Separate command submission from waiting for completion; resource/fence lifetime limits which waits may be removed.
Track modified ranges with their sync generation; a narrower invalidation needs every relevant writer recorded. Previously downloaded primary source; web replay unavailable this refresh.

decisions.1095: Private four-file port prepared on exact pacing/ef54 base. Three files apply cleanly, CreateGPU ReadSwitch context adapted while retaining Span switch. No fullbuild or gameplay test yet. Clang23 ThinLTO differs from upstream MSVC; no local gain prediction. Existing shadow/reference fixes retained.
decisions.1094: Not ported. Word-level copy tracking and DMAClear byte-count fix merit separate audit. Second commit skips a writer wait based on the observed shape of command entries; upstream explicitly notes a first compute-written command header would be read without that write, and DRAIN_CHECK is not included. Need a proof or guard before adopting that relaxation.
decisions.whole_rebase: Latest branch also forces shader cache v2; previous fully warmed private v2 migration stalled black. Keep qualified base and review ports independently until migration is qualified. No installed source/config changed.
decisions.FSR4: Official Lichii7afad54 removes Linux library path and uses Windows AMD signed runtime. Superbuildv37 release body describes an earlier generic library design. Do not claim Linux/RADV support from that text; RX6000 hardware support on Windows is a separate fact.
decisions.Orchid092: Xenoblade preemptive reads and Wonder submitted-time reports are game-specific changes; no local Zelda gain demonstrated.
decisions.Superbuildv37: Release published19:55; branch head67416d45213aa57055ee85e2c3bdffd896a9375d already describes futurev38. Tag release and moving branch are distinct; v38 availability not proven.
decisions.Fritchii: Nov4 shader translation/inline waited pipeline changes target Kirby; compare actual code before re-porting. No measured Zelda pipeline queue bottleneck yet.

later_first_commit_caveat: Read-only follow-up: first1094 commit01ce603 is not word-tracking-only. It also changes GPU-written-list wait from WaitForWriters to WaitForSyncedWriters and publishes queued entries before waiting. A port preserving all waits must select BufferCache/DMAClear hunks and exclude scheduler changes explicitly; no such selective port or tests yet.
